info.timeAllocation:
Hours Per Course: 30 sessions

1 session = 90 minutes
info.description: This is Skillful Reading 4 course, extracted from Skillful reading and writing 4 and intended to use for Upper-intermediate students. After the course, students can be able to use reading techniques (previewing, scanning, skimming, etc.) to comprehend reading passages related to academic topics such as psychology, Sociology, Biology, Chemistry, Business Studies.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

clos.loDetails: Identify the writer's position and identifying reasons and evidence of an argument
Identify and express contrasts; identify references to things outside the text
Understand analogies in a text and identify sources of information
Assess whether research supports an argument
Identify different perspectives and recognize trends and patterns
Use headings to understand the main ideas and identify fact, speculation and opinion
Identify persuasion techniques and assess the logic of an argument
Identify concepts and theories and inferring criticism
Identify logical fallacies and express causality
